providers.title: Strong Kadison–Kastler stability
providers.scope: For every eps > 0 there is delta(eps) > 0 such that unital von Neumann algebras M, N on any Hilbert space with d(M, N) < delta(eps) satisfy uMu* = N for a unitary u with ||u - I|| < eps; delta depends on eps alone. Proved in lessons 2 to 17 (lesson 17, Theorem 2.1).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Close separable C*-algebras without spatial conjugacy
providers.scope: For every eps > 0 there are unital norm-separable C*-algebras A, B on a separable Hilbert space with common identity, d(A, B) < eps and A'' = B'', such that no unitary u satisfies uAu* = B. Proved in lessons 18 and 19.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One-sided near inclusions without small spatial embeddings
providers.scope: There are eps_0 > 0 and unital von Neumann algebras M_n, N_n on separable Hilbert spaces with gamma(M_n, N_n) -> 0 such that, for large n, unitaries u with uM_nu* in N_n exist and all satisfy ||u - I|| >= eps_0. Proved in lessons 20 and 21, with eps_0 = 1/20000.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Commutants of close algebras
providers.scope: If d_cb(A, B) <= gamma, then every h in A' satisfies dist(h, B') <= gamma ||h||, and d(A', B') <= 2 gamma.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Close representations
providers.scope: Normal representations rho, theta of a von Neumann algebra with ||rho - theta||_cb <= e < 2 are conjugate by a unitary u with ||u - I|| <= e.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A common infinite family of isometries
providers.scope: If unital von Neumann algebras M, N contain a common infinite family of isometries, then d_cb(M, N) = d(M, N).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Christensen's theorem on injective near inclusions
providers.scope: If R is injective and nearly included in Q within gamma < 1/100, a unitary v in the von Neumann algebra generated by R and Q satisfies vRv* in Q and ||v - I|| <= 150 gamma; with the reverse near inclusion and gamma < 1/101, vRv* = Q. Used without proof, as named result N1 (Cameron, Christensen, Sinclair, Smith, White and Wiggins, Theorem 3.3(i)).
providers.status: named result: stated without proof, with free sources in the lesson; no proof in the programme yet

providers.title: Multiplication perturbations (Ricard and Roydor)
providers.scope: An associative bilinear map m on a von Neumann algebra P with ||m - m_P||_cb <= 1/11 is carried to the product of P by a completely bounded bijection L with ||L - id||_cb <= 10 ||m - m_P||_cb. Used without proof, as named result N2.
providers.status: named result: stated without proof, with free sources in the lesson; no proof in the programme yet

providers.title: The completely positive criterion
providers.scope: If F: P -> Q is UCP with ||F - rho||_cb <= e < 10^-3 for a faithful normal representation rho, and every contraction of Q lies within g of rho(P)_1 with g + e < 1, then a normal *-isomorphism theta: P -> Q with ||theta - rho||_cb <= 32e is implemented by a unitary u with ||u - I|| <= 32e.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Tensor gaps
providers.scope: If d_cb(A, B) <= gamma, the same bound holds after tensoring both algebras with B(K), or with a von Neumann algebra D whose commutant is generated by an increasing sequence of finite-dimensional algebras.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Boundary means
providers.scope: Every countable group G acts nonsingularly on a standard probability space D with an equivariant positive unital conditional mean m from L^infty(G x D) to L^infty(D) that is a module map over L^infty(D); likewise for G x G on D x D.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Correction of measurable cocycles
providers.scope: A family of measurable unitary fields whose cocycle defect e is at most 1/64 lies within 2e of an exact measurable cocycle.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Averaged intertwiners
providers.scope: An exact cocycle within delta < 1 of a unitary representation U is intertwined with U by a measurable unitary field L with ||L - I|| <= 2 delta.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Diagonal comparison
providers.scope: For an exact cocycle W with values in a finite von Neumann algebra and r = sup ||W_g(x)W_g(y)* - I|| < 1 there is a measurable unitary field a on D x D with ||a - I|| <= 2r and a(x, y) = W_g(x) a(g^-1 x, g^-1 y) W_g(y)*.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Double ergodicity with unitary coefficients
providers.scope: A bounded measurable vector field on D x D that transforms under a unitary representation of G along the diagonal action is almost everywhere a constant invariant vector.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite neighbours
providers.scope: A unital von Neumann algebra at distance less than 1/10 from a finite factor is a finite factor.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Popa's irreducible hyperfinite subfactor
providers.scope: Every II_1 factor M with separable predual contains a hyperfinite II_1 subfactor R, generated by an increasing sequence of full matrix algebras, with R' n M = C1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The bimodular test
providers.scope: An operator V on L^2(M) commuting with the left and right actions of R satisfies ||V|| <= 384 sup |<V a Omega, b Omega>| over contractions a, b of M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Common tracial position
providers.scope: Close II_1 factors (mutual gaps g < 1.74 x 10^-13) sharing an injective subalgebra that contains its relative commutant have representations in common standard tracial position within beta < 50948 sqrt(g). Used without proof, as named result N3 (Cameron, Christensen, Sinclair, Smith, White and Wiggins, Lemma 4.10).
providers.status: named result: stated without proof, with free sources in the lesson; no proof in the programme yet

providers.title: The two conjugations are close
providers.scope: For II_1 factors in common standard tracial position with a common irreducible hyperfinite subfactor acting alike on the right, d(M, N) < b implies ||J_M - J_N|| <= 768 b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Herstein's orientation lemma
providers.scope: A surjective Jordan homomorphism from a unital complex algebra onto a factor is a homomorphism or an antihomomorphism.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An isomorphism in common tracial position
providers.scope: II_1 factors in common standard tracial position with a common irreducible hyperfinite subfactor and d(M, N) < b < 1/1564 admit a normal *-isomorphism theta with ||theta(x) - x|| <= 252 b on the unit ball.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Strong stability of finite factors
providers.scope: There are t_fin > 0 and eta_fin(t) -> 0 such that a finite factor M and a von Neumann algebra N on a separable Hilbert space with d(M, N) < t < t_fin are conjugate by a unitary within eta_fin(t) of I.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Absorbing a fixed factor
providers.scope: For every factor A with separable predual, the tensor product of A with the fixed factor D is a factor of type III_1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Irreducible hyperfinite subfactors in type III_1 factors
providers.scope: A type III_1 factor P with separable predual has a faithful normal state phi and a hyperfinite II_1 factor R in the centralizer of phi, generated by full matrix algebras of sizes 2^j, with R' n P = C1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Preparing an infinite pair
providers.scope: Infinite factors M_0, N_0 on a separable space with d(M_0, N_0) < t < 4 x 10^-9 become, after tensoring with D and unitaries within 3 x 10^7 t of I in total, a prepared pair with d_cb <= 6 x 10^7 t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform graph comparison
providers.scope: For a prepared pair with d_cb(M, N) <= gamma, the projections onto the rescaled graphs of the Tomita operators satisfy sup_c ||E_c^M - E_c^N|| <= 5 x 10^5 gamma.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Logarithmic modular cuts
providers.scope: For a prepared pair with d_cb(M, N) <= gamma and every real a, the spectral projections of log Delta_N for (-inf, a - 1/2] and of log Delta_M for [a + 1/2, inf) have product of norm at most 2.1 x 10^6 gamma, and symmetrically.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sakai's theorem
providers.scope: Every derivation of a simple unital C*-algebra is inner. Used without proof, as named result N4.
providers.status: named result: stated without proof, with free sources in the lesson; no proof in the programme yet

providers.title: The uniform infinitesimal estimate
providers.scope: There is an absolute constant K with dist(h, P + P') <= K sup over contractions x of P of dist([h, x], P), for every separably acting type III factor P and every self-adjoint h.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Paths of approximate normalizers
providers.scope: A norm-continuous path of unitaries starting at 1 that moves the unit ball of P within e < e_0 of P stays within C_path e of the group U(P)U(P'), on intervals of any length.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Small exact normalizers
providers.scope: A unitary normalizer v of a factor P with ||v - 1|| < 1/6 factors as v = ab' with a in U(P), b' in U(P') and ||a - 1|| + ||b' - 1|| <= 10 ||v - 1||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Arveson's distance formula
providers.scope: For every nest and every operator T, the distance from T to the nest algebra is the supremum over the nest of ||(1 - N) T N||, and it is attained.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Approximation by analytic multipliers
providers.scope: Every bounded operator field F on the line is within ||(1 - P_0) M_F P_0|| of an analytic bounded field.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Near normalizers at every time
providers.scope: For a prepared pair with d_cb(M, N) <= gamma < gamma_0 and every real t there is a unitary n_t with n_t M n_t* = M and ||n_t - Delta_N^(it) Delta_M^(-it)|| <= C gamma, with absolute constants.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Correction of normalizer representations
providers.scope: Normalizers v_t of a factor, t real, with sup ||v_t v_s - v_(t+s)|| = e < 1/7208 lie within 4e of a representation of the discrete group of reals by normalizers.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A common modular action
providers.scope: For a prepared pair with d_cb(M, N) < gamma < c_mod there is a unitary q within C_mod gamma of 1 such that qMq* is normalized by the modular group of N and d_cb(qMq*, N) <= C_mod gamma.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conjugacy through a crossed product
providers.scope: Von Neumann algebras P, Q normalized by one strongly continuous unitary group U, with d_cb(P, Q) < gamma < gamma_0 and C(Q, U) a factor of type II_infinity, are conjugate by a unitary within zeta(gamma) of 1, where zeta(gamma) -> 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Strong stability of separably acting factors
providers.scope: There are t_fac > 0 and eta_fac(t) -> 0 such that factors on a separable Hilbert space with d(M_0, N_0) < t < t_fac are conjugate by a unitary within eta_fac(t) of I, for factors of every type.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Dixmier's approximation theorem
providers.scope: For every element x of a von Neumann algebra and every eps > 0, an averaging map brings x within eps of the center; for self-adjoint x, the norm-closed convex hull of its unitary orbit meets the center.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Close centers
providers.scope: d(Z(M), Z(N)) <= 3 d(M, N); if d(M, N) < g < 1/303, a unitary within 450 g of 1 carries Z(M) onto Z(N).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Measurable implementers
providers.scope: For algebras with a common center, fiberwise implementing unitaries within a of 1 can be chosen measurably and assemble into one implementing unitary within a of 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Stability on separable Hilbert spaces
providers.scope: For every a > 0 there is delta_sep(a) > 0 such that unital von Neumann algebras on a separable Hilbert space with d(M, N) < delta_sep(a) are conjugate by a unitary within a of 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Strong Kadison–Kastler stability on arbitrary Hilbert spaces
providers.scope: For every eps > 0 there is delta > 0, depending on eps alone, such that unital von Neumann algebras on any Hilbert space with d(M, N) < delta are conjugate by a unitary within eps of 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matrix distances and commutants
providers.scope: For every eps > 0 there is delta > 0 such that d(M, N) < delta implies d_cb(M, N) < eps and d(M', N') < eps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Algebras of convergent sequences
providers.scope: For unital subalgebras P, Q of an algebra D with trivial center, the algebras of sequences in D converging into P, respectively Q, are at distance d(P, Q), have the same commutant, and every unitary conjugating one onto the other yields normalizers U_n of D with U_n p_b U_n* -> b for every b in Q.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The obstruction
providers.scope: If P has the spatial tensor-norm identity relative to D and Q does not, the two sequence algebras are not unitarily conjugate; if WPW* = Q for a unitary W, their distance is at most 2 ||W - I||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A uniformly small deformation
providers.scope: For 0 < t < 1, the unitary representation pi_t of the free group on countably many generators with <pi_t(s_j) delta_e, delta_e> = t satisfies ||pi_t(g) - lambda(g)|| <= t + t^2 + t/(1 - t) for every group element g.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Failure of the tensor-norm identity
providers.scope: For 0 < t < 1, the subalgebra P_t fails the spatial tensor-norm identity relative to D: m generators with m > 4/t^2 give a product of norm at least mt and a tensor of norm at most 2 sqrt(m).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The circle family
providers.scope: There are unitary representations pi_z of the free group, z on the unit circle, with pi_z(g) = sum over k of z^k A_k(g), ||A_k(g)|| <= c_k uniformly in g, and pi_z(s_j) -> tz p_e weakly as j -> infinity.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The near inclusion
providers.scope: For unitary matrices U, V the von Neumann algebras M and N built from the circle family satisfy W*MW in N and gamma(M, N) <= C ||UV - VU||, with C = 61952 for t = 1/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Voiculescu's matrices
providers.scope: For n >= 3 the clock and shift matrices U_n, V_n have commutator norm nu_n = 2 sin(pi/n), and every commuting pair of unitaries is at total distance at least 1 - nu_n/2 from (U_n, V_n).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A commuting corner
providers.scope: Operators in two commuting von Neumann algebras within delta <= 1/400 in total of E_1 R_1 and E_2 R_2 give commuting unitaries within 305 delta of R_1 and R_2 on the finite-dimensional range of E_1 E_2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No small spatial embeddings
providers.scope: For the algebras M_n, N_n built from the clock and shift matrices, gamma(M_n, N_n) <= C nu_n -> 0, M_n embeds spatially in N_n, and every unitary u with uM_nu* in N_n satisfies ||u - I|| >= 1/9760 - C nu_n/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
